worldcombat.skill.memento.summary: Sacrifices the user to leave a remnant that lowers nearby enemies’ Attack and Sp. Atk and can disrupt their attacks. It does not sacrifice the user when no enemy is in range.
worldcombat.skill.memento.use.0: Cripple the pack closing in while at low HP
worldcombat.skill.memento.use.1: Trade one life to collapse a key threat's output
worldcombat.skill.memento.use.2: Leave a remnant to keep the pressure at the moment you are doomed
worldcombat.skill.memento.description.0: First applies Grief to visible enemies in range for %1$s. While grieving, each move or ordinary attack has a 20% chance to fail; movement remains available.
worldcombat.skill.memento.description.1: The initial radius is %1$s blocks. The remnant lasts %3$s and affects enemies in clear sight within %4$s blocks: each target loses up to %2$s Attack and Sp. Atk stages once, while Grief is refreshed nearby. Stage losses remain until encounter recovery or removal.
worldcombat.skill.memento.description.2: The user sacrifices itself and leaves a remnant only if at least one enemy is in clear sight within the initial area.
worldcombat.skill.memento.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
The companion only considers giving itself away once its health ratio falls below this value; higher sacrifices sooner, lower keeps it for a truly hopeless moment.
When on, the companion may leave its post to give the gift under a Hold order.
world_combat.move.memento.text.wasted: No one nearby; the gift cannot be given
